card.name: Spots right before a range appears
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a noun right after a quantity or list item, where a range such as 'range from 1 to 2', '(up to ...)' or ': range 4-33' is about to follow.

modes.label: Opening bracket after dose
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a dose amount, before an upper limit or equivalent value.
modes.example: the recommended dose is 0.2 mL/kg<< (>>0.1 mmol/kg) administered

modes.label: Item before 'range from'
modes.description: A noun or closing bracket for a parameter whose allowed values are given next as a range.
modes.example: Rows (on a two line display<<)>> range from 1 to 2;

modes.label: Colon or semicolon in stats
modes.description: Punctuation after a median or a defined label, where a range or value spread comes next.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output the word range (and its forms) next.
card.plain: It fires where a value has just been given and the text is about to state a range or limit.
